correctness.rationale: With P=af, Q=be, R=cd, the homogeneous determinant equals (P−Q−R)²−4QR. At a=1, w=f−be−cd is a polynomial coordinate with polynomial inverse. The chart derivatives in the new coordinates generate (w,cde,bde,bce,bcd); the change-of-variables Jacobian is invertible, and Euler's homogeneous identity supplies the missing homogeneous derivative because F itself lies in this ideal. A monomial in b,c,d,e vanishes on every coordinate two-plane iff its support has at least three variables. This gives the six-prime decomposition as an equality of ideals, ruling out nilpotents and embedded components there. Index permutations are transitive on the six edges, so the computation covers all of projective space. On a≠0, setting one variable from each of the complementary pairs {b,e},{c,d} to zero gives four coordinate planes; setting b=e=0 or c=d=0 gives the chart of one of the indicated quadrics. Cycling the complementary pairs exhausts the eight distinct planes and three quadrics; each quadric is a smooth rank-four quadric on its coordinate P³. All components are surfaces of degrees 1 and 2 respectively, so the top-dimensional degree is 14. At the vertex the complete local ring is the stated completion; its maximal-ideal associated graded ring is the squarefree cubic quotient. Counting monomials by support gives 1+4t/(1−t)+6t²/(1−t)². The graph K4 is connected and pure of dimension one with nonempty zero-dimensional vertex links, so the associated face ring is Cohen–Macaulay by the graph case of Reisner's criterion, as is its completion. The multiplicity is 6. An independent exact replay formed all six homogeneous partials and compared Gröbner bases over Q on each of the six charts, then checked the series and multiplicity. This is compatible with base change to C and complements the all-degree argument.
residual_risks: The calculation proves reducedness for the projective scheme (the saturated ideal); no assertion about behavior of the unsaturated affine Jacobian ideal at the cone origin or about the ambient hypersurface's vertex multiplicity is needed.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Assigning reduced structures on listed components and taking their scheme union produces the radical, not a proof that the derivative ideal already equals it. Even generic reducedness and an exact reduced-union presentation leave room for an embedded structure at intersections. The all-chart Jacobian equality supplies the missing step. Once that equality is known, degree, completed vertex model, and Hilbert series follow, rather than being stand-alone novelty claims.

originality.rationale: Pass for identifying the full Jacobian scheme with the reduced union and with the multiplicity-six local scheme at coordinate vertices. The ambient quartic, support and generic types are established prior work. The same-day hollow rank-two result is particularly close: after including the two row-zero planes it mechanically recovers the six-branch reduced union. It does not identify that union with the full homogeneous-partial ideal, so does not rule out extra scheme structure on the rank-three branches or intersections. The equality to the Jacobian scheme is the distinct claim; the support count, degree of the reduced support, and its vertex consequences receive no separate originality credit.
residual_risks: The calculation is short enough to occur in earlier notes using the discriminant or quotient model. Bounded literature and database checks cannot exclude this.
No intra-day priority follows from the two related same-date records.

value.rationale: The scheme cut out by the derivatives is a natural invariant of this independently studied discriminant and squared Grassmannian. An exact radical chart ideal on a cover answers what a support or generic-node calculation cannot: whether extra scheme structure appears at component crossings. The vertex calculation specifies the actual local Jacobian scheme where six branches meet. This is useful even though the decisive ideal calculation is elementary and the reduced support and its degree were already accessible.
residual_risks: This does not classify the full hypersurface germ along every intersection or extend the Jacobian result to larger hollow determinants.
